title: crepis sancta subsp. obovata
intro: Crepis sancta subsp. obovata, commonly known as a rare subspecies of the lesser meadow sowthistle, is a flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Crepis sancta subsp. obovata are thought to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for various infections and conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
